summary: Implemented parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError in rdflib/extras/shacl.py, with tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) using the shared venv interpreter. Nothing is committed and no other files changed. mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading the code only. Lines are within 88 columns. No explicit non-node guard was added because Graph.value returns None immediately when subject and object are None, so None does not act as a wildcard.
